0.name: The Fool
0.crypto_metaphor: New investor entering crypto, first token purchase, launching new protocol, YOLO trades
0.bull_market: Fresh capital entering, retail FOMO beginning
0.bear_market: Catching falling knives, buying the dip too early
mystical_phrases: The journey of a thousand gains begins with a single trade
Innocence and wisdom dance at the edge of the blockchain
Every expert was once a fool who dared to try

1.name: The Magician
1.crypto_metaphor: Smart contract developer, DeFi wizard, utilizing all tools and platforms
1.bear_market: Building in the bear, creating new protocols
mystical_phrases: As above in the cloud, so below on-chain
All elements align when the coder becomes the code
Power flows through those who understand the protocol

2.name: The High Priestess
2.crypto_metaphor: Hidden knowledge, insider information, understanding market psychology, intuitive trading
2.bull_market: Knowing when to take profits, sensing the top
mystical_phrases: The blockchain remembers what humans forget
Between the pump and dump lies infinite wisdom
She who holds the private keys holds the power

3.name: The Empress
3.crypto_metaphor: Abundant portfolios, fertile investment ground, passive income, yield generation
mystical_phrases: Abundance flows to those who plant in bear markets
The mother of all bull runs gestates in darkness
Your seeds of investment bloom in divine timing

4.name: The Emperor
4.crypto_metaphor: Bitcoin dominance, established protocols, regulatory framework, institutional investment
mystical_phrases: The throne of dominance shifts but never falls
Structure provides freedom for the wise investor
Even emperors began as anonymous founders

5.name: The Hierophant
5.crypto_metaphor: Traditional finance meeting crypto, education, following established strategies
5.bear_market: Returning to fundamentals, learning from history
mystical_phrases: Ancient wisdom flows through new protocols
The teacher appears when the trader is ready
Sacred knowledge hides in whitepapers

6.name: The Lovers
6.crypto_metaphor: Choosing between tokens, partnership formations, community bonds, DEX pairs
6.bull_market: FOMO vs HODL decisions, portfolio balancing
6.bear_market: Choosing what to keep, what to cut
mystical_phrases: Two tokens diverge, but only one leads home
The heart knows what charts cannot show
Perfect pairs create impermanent gains

7.name: The Chariot
7.crypto_metaphor: Momentum trading, riding trends, controlled aggression in markets
mystical_phrases: Harness the wild horses of volatility
Victory belongs to those who steer through chaos
The chariot moves only when opposing forces unite

8.name: Strength
8.crypto_metaphor: Diamond hands, emotional control during volatility, patience in markets
mystical_phrases: True strength is holding when others fold
The lion of volatility bows to patient hands
Gentle persistence melts diamond resistance

9.name: The Hermit
9.crypto_metaphor: DYOR, solo research, finding alpha alone, bear market building
9.bull_market: Stepping back from hype, seeking truth
mystical_phrases: In solitude, the alpha whispers clearly
The hermit's lantern illuminates hidden protocols
Withdraw from noise to hear the signal

10.name: Wheel of Fortune
10.crypto_metaphor: Market cycles, bull and bear transitions, sudden pumps or dumps
10.bear_market: The wheel turns, patience for next cycle
mystical_phrases: The wheel turns: bears become bulls, bulls become bears
Fortune favors those who understand cycles
What drops must rise, what rises must drop

11.name: Justice
11.crypto_metaphor: Smart contract execution, regulatory decisions, karma in markets, fair launch
mystical_phrases: The blockchain never forgets, never forgives
Every transaction balances in the cosmic ledger
Justice is code executing without emotion

12.name: The Hanged Man
12.crypto_metaphor: Waiting for entry, different perspective on markets, sacrifice for gains
mystical_phrases: Suspended between pump and dump, wisdom emerges
Sometimes you must hang to see clearly
Sacrifice the quick gain for lasting wealth

13.name: Death
13.crypto_metaphor: Protocol deaths, end of bull market, transformation of the space, rebirth
mystical_phrases: Every rug pull fertilizes tomorrow's innovation
Death of one protocol births another
In crypto winter, spring seeds are planted

14.name: Temperance
14.crypto_metaphor: Portfolio balance, DCA strategy, risk management, moderation
mystical_phrases: Balance the FOMO with the FUD
The middle path leads to sustainable gains
Mix patience with action, caution with courage

15.name: The Devil
15.crypto_metaphor: Greed, addiction to charts, leverage trading, scams and rugpulls
mystical_phrases: The chains you forge link you to liquidation
Greed whispers sweetly before the rug pulls
Your demons live in the leverage slider

16.name: The Tower
16.crypto_metaphor: Market crash, protocol hack, sudden liquidation, black swan event
16.bull_market: Sudden crash from ATH, reality check
mystical_phrases: Lightning strikes the highest market caps first
From the rubble of crashes, innovation rises
The tower falls so stronger foundations can be built

17.name: The Star
17.crypto_metaphor: Hope in bear market, promising new project, recovery beginning
mystical_phrases: Stars shine brightest in the darkest bear markets
Hope is the alpha that charts cannot measure
Follow the star to your destined protocol

18.name: The Moon
18.crypto_metaphor: Uncertainty, FUD, hidden information, manipulation, illusions
mystical_phrases: Not all moons are real, some are merely shadows
In the moon's light, shitcoins look like gold
Fear and greed dance under the crypto moon

19.name: The Sun
19.crypto_metaphor: Bull market peak, maximum euphoria, success and profits
mystical_phrases: The sun shines on all portfolios equally
In the sun's light, even shitcoins sparkle
Bask in gains but remember: suns set

20.name: Judgment
20.crypto_metaphor: Reckoning with past trades, tax season, portfolio evaluation
mystical_phrases: The blockchain judges without mercy or prejudice
Every trade echoes in eternity's ledger
Rise from the ashes of your liquidations

21.name: The World
21.crypto_metaphor: Complete market cycle, achieving goals, full adoption, integration
mystical_phrases: The world is your DEX, trade wisely
Full circles bring you back to better beginnings
Completion is just another word for new genesis

wands.market_meaning: Startup tokens, new protocols, creative solutions

cups.market_meaning: Community coins, social sentiment, emotional trading

swords.market_meaning: Technical analysis, FUD/shill wars, market commentary

pentacles.crypto_aspect: Wealth, material gains, stability, long-term value
pentacles.market_meaning: Stablecoins, blue chips, store of value, actual profits

love.crypto_twist: Finding your soulmate token, partnership protocols

spiritual.crypto_twist: Understanding the deeper meaning of decentralization
